source_policy: R13 pilots establish feasibility/interfaces only; R14 budgets are frozen before R15 and are not effect estimates.

history_crossing.rationale: Central rare-event mechanism; exact-binomial endpoint and multiple reduced widths/rounds.

collision_preimage.rationale: First-hit/right-censored families need survival estimates across geometric widths.

tmto.rationale: Paired strategy/constructive frontier; primary object is Pareto geometry, not a small p-value.

parameter_uniformity.rationale: 93 joint (t,k) cells receive 1000 expected observations per cell under ideal uniformity.

kdf_pow_branch.rationale: Paired designs with bootstrap intervals; identical workloads within replicate.

external_statistics.rationale: Secondary descriptive control with standard-hash and deliberately broken baselines.

negative_result_rule: No success means only no success within the declared budget.
